pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Violet Firmament Heavenly Flame stands at the summit of the nine forging fires. Its violet radiance carries the overwhelming power of heavenly fire, reaching temperatures as high as 12,000°C.

pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: It is the only listed flame capable of meeting forging targets of 10,500°C or higher. Artifacts forged with it gain an additional 25 quality points, potentially surpassing ordinary quality limits.
